svg.title: Stage 00 Formal Statement & Comparator Audit Architecture
svg.desc: Three-column architecture diagram of Stage 00 formal contracts, proof entry and equivalence bridge, and independent comparator and kernel audit specifications. Column 1 shows upstream statement and challenge contracts: src/Statements.lean (4 Prop definitions), src/Challenge.lean (5 sorry target specs), and comparator/FormalConjecturesStatement.lean with FormalConjecturesChallenge.lean. Column 2 shows proof and bridge modules: src/Main.lean (importing Statements and proving all 5 targets), comparator/FormalConjecturesBridge.lean (reviewer-authored equivalence proof to external formal-conjectures specs), and comparator/FormalConjecturesSolution.lean (importing Main and FormalConjecturesBridge to discharge both RH and GRH targets). Column 3 shows comparator.json and formal-conjectures.json (permitted axioms propext, Quot.sound, Classical.choice; external kernels leanchecker-paranoid and nanoda_bin) alongside an amber dashed Local Audit Snapshot box for upstream commit c900e67c2fcd reporting build_status unverified-locally, 0 forbidden tokens in solution on entry static scan, and 7 expected challenge sorrys.
svg.text: Stage 00 Formal Statement & Comparator Audit Architecture
